item.title: Do-over: FA Cup game to be replayed because of referee error
item.description: Manchester United only got a mea culpa for a refereeing error in a 1-0 loss to Manchester City earlier this month

item.title: Who should be believed? Trump's social media post on golf course leads lawyers back to court
item.description: Donald Trump’s social media posts on the closure and renovation of a historic golf course in the nation’s capital are putting Justice Department lawyers in the uncomfortable position of explaining whether the president of the United States should be believed

item.title: US military says 5 were killed by a strike on an alleged drug boat in the eastern Pacific
item.description: The U.S. military says it has attacked a boat it accused of smuggling drugs in the eastern Pacific Ocean

item.title: A ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city holds for its first 30 hours, officials say
item.description: Officials say that a six-day ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in southern Ukraine has held for its first day and night

item.title: Romanian president calls alleged Russian sabotage plot a 'grave violation' of NATO member's security
item.description: Romanian President Nicusor Dan calls an alleged Russian sabotage plot a “grave violation” of the NATO member’s sovereignty and security

item.title: Iran hasn't tried to repair nuclear facilities damaged in US strikes, UN nuclear chief says
item.description: The head of the U.N. nuclear agency says there's been no indication Iran has tried to repair or reconstruct its nuclear facilities damaged in U.S. and Israeli military strikes this year or last year

item.title: Japanese manga artist Tetsuya Chiba, known for his boxing masterpiece 'Ashita no Joe,' dies at 87
item.description: Tetsuya Chiba, a legendary Japanese manga artist best known for his boxing series “Ashita no Joe,” or “Fighting for Tomorrow,” has died

item.title: California appeals court upholds actor Danny Masterson's rape convictions
item.description: A California appeals court has upheld actor Danny Masterson’s convictions and long prison sentence for raping two women at his home in 2003

item.title: Ken Burns wins a $250,000 prize for bringing American history to life
item.description: Ken Burns has won a $250,000 prize for his contributions to American history

item.title: Tech sector rally continues with Fed expected to leave benchmark interest rate alone
item.description: Tech stocks have surged this week ahead of a meeting of the U.S. Federal Reserve with markets anticipating no change to the benchmark U.S. interest rate, at least not yet

item.title: A US cruise ship suspends a global voyage in Asia due to fuel costs, stranding 200 passengers
item.description: A U.S. cruise ship on a three-year voyage has suspended its journey in Cambodia due to high fuel costs, forcing hundreds of passengers to disembark

item.title: South Korea fines Google and Apple over unfair app market practices
item.description: South Korea on Wednesday fined Google and Apple a combined $47.6 million, saying they abused their dominance in app store markets by forcing local developers onto their own payment systems and by unfairly delaying app reviews

item.title: Risks spelled out for Anthropic investors include blowback from runaway AI
item.description: Any time a company looks to start selling shares on Wall Street, it’s required to disclose potential risks for investors

item.title: Malaysia seizes servers with advanced AI chips suspected of violating export controls
item.description: Malaysia's customs department has seized 30 servers with advanced AI chips in a suspected export-control violation
